datasets.name: Australian Road Deaths Database — Fatalities
datasets.description: Road crash fatalities in Australia by date, state, road user type and crash characteristics. Monthly series maintained by BITRE.

provenance.publisher: Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics
provenance.attribution: Source: Bureau of Infrastructure and Transport Research Economics (BITRE), Australian Road Deaths Database. Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia.
transformations: Decoded as utf-8-sig (source was not UTF-8)
Selected columns: Crash ID, State, Month, Year, Dayweek, Time, Crash Type, Speed Limit, Road User, Gender, Age Group

Renamed headers: Crash ID to crash_id, State to state, Month to month, Year to year, Dayweek to day_of_week, Time to time, Crash Type to crash_type, Speed Limit to speed_limit, Road User to road_user, Gender to gender, Age Group to age_group
Kept the most recent 4000 rows of 5635 (row cap)

datasets.pii_note: Aggregate incident records with no personal identifiers. Gender and age group are present as coarse categories. Expect the privacy filter to find nothing, which is the point of including this dataset: it is the honest contrast against the synthetic fixtures where it finds everything.
